summary: Computes a 3x3 inverse coordinate transform. Transforms two input vectors stored in the workspace buffer via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, then assembles cofactor-based inverse matrix rows and applies additional matrix-vector products to build the inverse transform and transformed vectors in the result buffer (this+0x10). Used by the vehicle physics pipeline to transform forces/vectors between coordinate frames.

local_names.this[1]: first matrix data block pointer (matrix at +28)
local_names.this[2]: workspace buffer pointer (input vectors at +24/+48, results at +72/+96)

operations.description: Matrix3x3VectorMultiply transforms the first input vector (workspace +24) by the matrix in the first block (block+28), storing the result at workspace +72.
Matrix3x3VectorMultiply transforms the second input vector (workspace +48) by the same matrix, storing the result at workspace +96.
First three result-buffer doubles are assembled as dot products combining elements of the second matrix block (this+0xC) with the two transformed workspace vectors.
Cross products and cofactor-based inverse matrix rows are computed into the result buffer (this+0x10): elements at this+0x28 through this+0x50 receive the cross-product/cofactor terms.
Remaining result-buffer elements (this+0x58 through this+0x80) receive the additional matrix-vector products that complete the inverse transform columns.
Function returns a pointer into the result buffer (this+0x10).
